summary: FD_TC_191_VOL (Pre-Move) ? INVOL (REACC) � Promise = Last VOL Before REACC
title: VOL (Pre-Move) ? INVOL (REACC) � Promise = Last VOL Before REACC
description:
Customer voluntarily changed their flight via Pre-Move (VOL), then the system auto-rebooked via REACC (INVOL) after a disruption. Validates that the promise updates to the last VOL arrival (13:00) and that the subsequent REACC does NOT further update the promise. Delay is calculated from the VOL-updated promise (13:00) to actual arrival (17:00).
